plan.comment: Plan by the member at the editor's word (17:1x London), for parts 2 and 3 while part 1 is on stage: infographics of documented attacks as blast radius; the solution in depth (SGit's architecture, the PKI, vault applications, its scale and features over Git); SHarness technical (the process behaviour policy, nothing granted unless needed, the KMS, the virtual file system, packet-level network control, digital twins, local to distributed across Kubernetes and clouds) with an invitation to the room to try to escape it; live vault embeds opened with a read key; the player checking every minute for new slides; a board of the team's work in the slide environment; the researcher surveys sgit.ai's and newsroom.sgit.ai's public vaults for embeddable demos (ABP before and after). 1) team/conductor/briefs/2026-10-29__editor/5-parts-2-and-3-1715.md. 2) Requests to researcher, deck, storyteller, dev, ruv.sgit, studio@, motion@; vault_check first. 3) pace.json, status.json. Rules: only read keys already published, never a write key; nothing attack-shaped beyond documented public incidents; locked parts untouched.

pre_review.comment: In scope; no stop condition. Conditions: embed only owner-published read keys, never a write or vault key; the minute poll loads nothing from a host the gate refuses; the escape-SHarness invitation states what is in scope and where to report.
